description: #2 — `${ (e) => { @r = 1 }; @r2 = 2 }`: in statement position `(e) => {` is the removed presence-guard form (§17.6); pre-round-4 the tail was dropped at exit 0. Position: engine.
rationale: §5.2.3: "The statement list is logic context — the same statement grammar as a function body (§7.3) … The block MAY span any number of lines." and "No statement of the block SHALL be dropped".
